name: betabud-gym-api
description: Get the numbers of your climbing gym from Beta Bud: sends, repeats, attempts, active climbers, grade agreement, climb quality, and setter feedback.
long_description:
This extension connects Claude to the Beta Bud Gym API. The API is read-only. It gives a gym its own numbers: sends, repeats, attempts, active climbers, grade agreement, climb quality, and setter feedback.

A gym admin makes an API token in Beta Bud, in **Gym Settings → API Access**. Paste the token when you install the extension. Beta Bud must turn the API on for the gym first.

The API gives no names, email addresses, or user ids of climbers.

tools.name: list_gyms
tools.description: List the gyms that the token covers, with the id and the timezone of each gym.

tools.name: get_gym
tools.description: Get one gym and its timezone.

tools.name: list_zones
tools.description: List the zones of a gym.

tools.name: list_grade_systems
tools.description: List the grade systems of a gym, with the grades in order.

tools.name: list_climbs
tools.description: List the climbs of a gym.

tools.name: get_climb_stats
tools.description: Get the opinions and the activity counts of one climb.

tools.name: list_climb_stats
tools.description: List the opinions and the activity counts of every climb of a gym.

tools.name: get_activity_summary
tools.description: Get the sends, repeats, attempts, and active people of a gym for each day.

tools.name: list_setter_feedback
tools.description: List the comments that climbers send to the setters.

api_token.title: Beta Bud API token
api_token.description: A gym admin makes the token in Beta Bud. Open Gym Settings → API Access, and select Create token. The token starts with bbk_.
